title: SPRK
tagline: SPRK is a Zircuit-powered NFT Launchpad for securing early investment in rising influencers.
description:
The core problem today about SocialFi and investing into influencers is that, these kind of project turn int ponzy schemes real quick and are not sustainable. We don't want that.

Our solution offers an NFT based support for early stage creators. Users can buy the NFT collections of influencers who they believe have potential. Early supporter NFT's will be cheaper and more rare.

Thanks to NFT's and not just tokenizing influencers, the system will be sustainable.

Holding NFT's will have perks as well. In future, we are planning to add special content feature, NFT holders are going to be able to watch special contents and interact with them.

Influencers are obviously going to benefit from this too. By getting the early support they need, it is going to be much easier for them to be seen and get popular.

We believe this solution is a win-win system and has a lot of potential. By combining all above with Zircuit's ai powered sequencer level security, our system is going to be safe of bots and hacks.
how_its_made:
We are a team of bunch of researchers and designers, some of us work at National Research Centers. But none of us had any developer background. 
We were very excited to see that Zircuit has a no code bounty, because we are a team of ideas. After brain storming what we can do on Zircuit, and seeing they wanted a "killer-app", we combined the security of Zircuit with our promising SocialFi idea. We believe supporting early stage influencers are important and doing this with techs like sequencer level security is crucial.

Our contracts are: NFT contract, Marketplace contract. that's it. On top of them, we are planning to add a fame metric ourselfs. Getting the stats of influencers social media accounts, and combining this metrics with their on chain reputation (calculated by how much malicios transactions they had) we are going to calculate the fame score.

We should not forget about the social consensus as well. We know metrics can be faked, thus we are also going to add a community score. This is going to be calculated with our users votes.

Using this metrics, users are going to invest long term with their NFTs. They are going invest in humans, humans they believe have potential.

We built only on Zircuit, no other partners. It was a great experience for all of us.
